player_prompt.intro:
Ni wewe Mugenzi {player_id} muri Connect Four.
Ishusho ya disiki yawe: {symbol}.
Ubutaka bw'umukino bufite {num_rows} amarangi na {num_cols} inyungu.
Abaugenzi bafata impinduka zikabije disiki yabo muri imwe mu nyungu (0 kugeza {end_col}).
Uwa mbere kuganisha (disiki zake) ine muri njia ya wima, ya mpande, cyangwa ya diagonal niwe ushindi.
Muri impinduka yawe, andika nambari ya inyungu muri hakuna zilizosongoshwa kugira ngo ukore ingendo yawe.
Urugero: '[col 4]' cyangwa '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Ikintu cyabaye si ngombwa cyane. Igihe kinabaye: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Ikintu cyabaye si ngombwa. Kigo {col} kiri hasi.
invalid_move.already_full: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Ikintu cyabaye si ngombwa. Kigo {col} kimeze.

action.dropped_disk: Umukinnyi {player_id} yashuye diski ye ({player_symbol}) mu kigo {col}.

outcome.win: Umukinnyi {player_id} atsinda iyo ahurije hamwe ine!
outcome.draw: Umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa.
